# TimerTrain

> TimerTrain is a free web-based sequential timer. Users line up several timers and it plays them one after another, switching automatically and repeating for a set number of rounds or endlessly. A whole setup is stored in the page URL, so it can be saved as a bookmark or shared as a link. No account, no install. Available in English, Japanese and Spanish.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No sign-up, no app install; runs in any modern browser on phone, tablet and desktop, and can be added to the home screen (PWA).
- Core feature: chain any number of timers (each with its own length, name and color), repeat the chain N times or infinitely.
- Sharing: the URL holds the full setup, e.g. `https://timertrain.com/en?t=red.1500.Work,blue.300.Break&r=4` is 25 min Work + 5 min Break, 4 rounds. Format: `t=color.seconds.name,...` and `r=rounds` (`inf` for endless).
- Colors: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, gray.
- Sound cues on every switch and at the finish, a 3-second countdown tick, screen kept awake while running, accurate in background tabs, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts and a full-screen focus mode on desktop.

## Main pages

- [TimerTrain (English)](https://timertrain.com/en): build a custom sequential / repeating multi-timer
- [TimerTrain (日本語)](https://timertrain.com/): 複数タイマーを連続・くり返し再生
- [TimerTrain (Español)](https://timertrain.com/es): temporizador secuencial

## Ready-made timers (English)

- [Pomodoro timer](https://timertrain.com/en-pomodoro): 25 min work + 5 min break
- [Study timer](https://timertrain.com/en-study): 50 min study + 10 min break
- [Interval timer](https://timertrain.com/en-interval-timer): custom work/rest intervals
- [Tabata timer](https://timertrain.com/en-tabata): 20 s on + 10 s off x 8
- [HIIT timer](https://timertrain.com/en-hiit): 40 s work + 20 s rest x 8
- [Kitchen timer](https://timertrain.com/en-kitchen): several cooking timers in a row
- [1 minute timer](https://timertrain.com/en-1-minute-timer)
- [5 minute timer](https://timertrain.com/en-5-minute-timer)
- [10 minute timer](https://timertrain.com/en-10-minute-timer)
- [25 minute timer](https://timertrain.com/en-25-minute-timer)
